topic: Laika, the first animal in orbit
script: The first animal to orbit Earth was a dog named Laika. She launched aboard the Soviet spacecraft Sputnik 2 in 1957. Laika had been a stray found on the streets of Moscow. Her flight showed that a living creature could survive launch and reach orbit. Sadly, she did not return, but her mission paved the way for human spaceflight.
